title: auth_header() allocates String for AUTHORIZATION name on every call
description: auth.rs BearerAuth::auth_header and BasicAuth::auth_header both call AUTHORIZATION.as_str().to_string() on every invocation, allocating a fresh String for the static literal 'authorization' on every HTTP request. The header name is a known static string; returning (&'static str, String) or caching it would eliminate the per-request allocation.
